answer: Splitting into 8 separate vaults requires a separate funded vertex account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The dawn explorer shows the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the canyon binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Honest users pay that once, farms 29 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
